country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Brightsolid Aberdeen Data Centre
notes: Brightsolid lists an Aberdeen Data Centre at Whitemyres Ave; Data Center Map says the facility was built in 2015 and is a Tier III accredited data centre. Silicon UK reported the site as a £5m facility with up to 25kW per rack.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: IFB Union Street
notes: Data Center Map lists IFB Union Street at 387 Union Street, Aberdeen. CityFibre says IFB provides managed digital services from its Aberdeen Data Centre, and AGCC reported IFB network investment connecting its data centre hubs.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: IFB Altens
notes: Data Center Map lists IFB Altens at 54 Hareness Road, Aberdeen. CityFibre noted IFB's new headquarters and data centre in Altens.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Blackdog Data Center Campus
notes: Proposed 200-acre campus at Blackdog, north of Aberdeen in Aberdeenshire. DCD reported a possible 600MW data center; AGCC/Press and Journal said the first phase includes 600MW renewable and grid-connected power and has Aberdeenshire Council approval for phase one/business-industrial use.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Zero Four, Montrose datacentre opportunity site
developer: Scottish Enterprise / Host in Scotland opportunity site
notes: Zero Four, Montrose was identified in Scottish Enterprise/Host in Scotland material as a high-potential datacentre site. Searches did not find a named developer, planning application, or active build, so this is recorded as opportunity-stage activity rather than a confirmed project.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Killellan AI Growth Zone / Sovereign AI Cloud
notes: Killellan/Cowal Peninsula proposal near Dunoon. Argyll Data Development says the campus will supply power directly to a data centre and has partnered with SambaNova. DCD reported an initial 100-600MW campus scalable higher; the AI Growth Zone application includes council/MSP support letters. A later APRS report says the project may be stalled by grid connection delays.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pulsant Edinburgh South Gyle SC-1
notes: Pulsant describes Edinburgh South Gyle SC-1 as Scotland's most connected data centre with 22+ on-site carriers. Edinburgh Chamber reported a completed £500k investment across three Edinburgh sites in June 2026.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: South Gyle / Edinburgh Green Campus
notes: APRS says the 213MW planning-permission-in-principle application at the Gyle was rejected by Edinburgh City Council in February 2026 and appealed. ERCS/APRS tables list South Gyle, Edinburgh, Shelborn Drummond Ltd, 212.42MW, application 25/04239/PPP.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Wester Hermiston Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura public consultation page states a proposed 200MW data centre campus on land at Wester Hermiston in the City of Edinburgh. ERCS lists EIA screening and PAN references 25/02924/SCR and 25/03978/PAN.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: CX Technology Campus / Chapelcross AI data centre campus
developer: CX Power; Nuclear Decommissioning Authority partners
notes: CX Technology Campus says Chapelcross will deliver hyperscale AI-enabled data centres with up to 161,920 sqm of data centre space and a one-gigawatt campus; planning permission in principle is targeted for December 2026 with phased construction from 2027 to 2035. UK NDA release says CX Power plans include potential for a 1GW data centre campus.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Eastriggs AI Growth Zone candidate site
notes: FarrPoint says Dumfries and Galloway Council commissioned an assessment of an AI Growth Zone candidate site at Eastriggs for data centre suitability. The council said it submitted an expression of interest for an AI Growth Zone and had enquiries from data centre operators.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Brightsolid Dundee Data Centre
notes: Brightsolid lists its Dundee HQ and Data Centre at Gateway House, Luna Place, Dundee Technology Park. Data Center Map lists Brightsolid Dundee at the same site; DC Thomson history says the Dundee data centre opened in 2005.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Rufus Data Centre Campus
notes: ILI Group says Rufus in East Ayrshire is part of The Stoics hyperscale green data centre network. The Rufus consultation page describes a proposed AI-focused data centre near Hurlford. DCD reported ILI is targeting East Ayrshire (Rufus) at 540MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Ochiltree / Creoch data centre
notes: DCD reported Apatura filed for an EIA Screening Opinion for a data center outside Cumnock, on 24.5 hectares south of Creoch Farm near Ochiltree. APRS describes the application as a 200MW data centre next to Killoch Colliery, with EIA required and planning reference 25/0003/EIASCR.
